C1146.title: U.S. DOJ Charges Two Defendants in the Frosties NFT Fraud Case
C1146.summary: On March 24, 2022, the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York announced that Ethan Nguyen and Andre Llacuna had been charged with conspiracy to commit wire fraud and conspiracy to commit money laundering over the Frosties NFT project. The complaint alleged that after the project sold out, the defendants shut its website and transferred about $1.1 million in proceeds among cryptocurrency wallets; each charge carried a maximum twenty-year prison term.
